name: Mcpa
description:
Add stdio MCP servers to Claude Code interactively or with arguments.

mcpa is a wrapper around `claude mcp add` that guides you through server name, command, args, env vars, and scope. Supports both direct mode (with arguments) and interactive mode (step-by-step prompts). Choose user scope to make a server available globally, or project scope to commit it to the repository.
longDescription:
Ships **1 command**, `add` (Add a stdio MCP server to Claude Code interactively or with arguments) and **1 hook**, `hooks.json`.

Installs with `claude plugin install mcpa@claude-community` from `yn01/claude-plugins` (`plugins/mcpa`).

A Claude Code plugin to add stdio MCP servers to Claude Code interactively or with arguments. A wrapper around `claude mcp add` that guides you through server name, command, args, env vars, and scope.
